assign.request: Stop the card page flicker: no-change live updates must not redraw

assign.outcome:
**The card page no longer redraws when nothing changed.** Live batches used to tear the whole card, the agents panel, the day index and the rail list down and rebuild them even when the data was identical — that was the flicker that "returns to the way it was".

Before: 61 DOM mutations in 8 idle seconds, and 4,994 when the live readers fire with no change. After: 0 idle, and 1 (the dev bar's own hidden attribute, outside AI 2). A real change now touches one row instead of 23.

![](card-1920.png)

Left: `live.js` (the Live card) still does a full `$box.empty()` — not on this page, not touched.
